result.instructions: Tools for Basis Theory, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Basis Theory data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run basis_theory_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run basis_theory_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run basis_theory_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. basis_theory_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: basis_theory_list_tokens
tools.title: List tokens
tools.description: List vault tokens as METADATA — id, type, container, fingerprint, metadata and timestamps. Does not return the underlying card number or PII. Basis Theory: GET /v2/tokens.

type.description: Only tokens of this type, e.g. card, bank, token.

container.description: Only tokens in this container path, e.g. /pci/high/.

fingerprint.description: Only tokens sharing this fingerprint — how you find duplicates of the same card.

start.description: Cursor from the previous page's pagination.next. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: basis_theory_search_tokens
tools.title: Search tokens
tools.description: Search tokens with Basis Theory's query syntax over metadata, e.g. metadata.customer_id:"cus_1". Returns metadata only. Read-only despite being a POST — the query goes in the body. Basis Theory: POST /v2/tokens/search.

query.description: Query string, e.g. type:card AND metadata.customer_id:"cus_1".

start.description: Cursor from the previous page's pagination.next. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: basis_theory_get_token
tools.title: Get one token
tools.description: Fetch a single token by id. Returns metadata, container, fingerprint and timestamps. WARNING: if the configured API key carries a reveal permission, the response also contains the token's plaintext data — issue this server a read-only management key instead. Basis Theory: GET /tokens/{id}.

tools.name: basis_theory_list_applications
tools.title: List applications
tools.description: List the applications (API-key holders) in the tenant, with their types and permissions. Basis Theory: GET /applications.

type.description: Only applications of this type, e.g. private, public, management, expiring.

tools.name: basis_theory_get_application
tools.title: Get one application
tools.description: Fetch a single application with its type and permission list. Basis Theory: GET /applications/{id}.

tools.name: basis_theory_whoami
tools.title: Identify the configured key
tools.description: Return the application the configured BT-API-KEY belongs to — the fastest way to check which permissions this server actually has. Basis Theory: GET /applications/key.

tools.name: basis_theory_list_logs
tools.title: List audit logs
tools.description: List audit-log entries — who did what to which entity and when. The tool for answering 'who touched this token?'. Basis Theory: GET /logs.

entity_type.description: Only entries for this entity type, e.g. token, application, proxy.

entity_id.description: Only entries for this entity id.

tools.name: basis_theory_list_log_entity_types
tools.title: List log entity types
tools.description: List the entity types the audit log records — the valid values for entity_type. Basis Theory: GET /logs/entity-types.

tools.name: basis_theory_list_proxies
tools.title: List proxies
tools.description: List the proxies that forward requests to third parties, detokenizing in flight. Basis Theory: GET /proxies.

tools.name: basis_theory_get_proxy
tools.title: Get one proxy
tools.description: Fetch a single proxy with its destination URL and transform configuration. Basis Theory: GET /proxies/{id}.

tools.name: basis_theory_list_reactors
tools.title: List reactors
tools.description: List reactors — the serverless functions that run against detokenized data inside the vault. Basis Theory: GET /reactors.

tools.name: basis_theory_get_reactor
tools.title: Get one reactor
tools.description: Fetch a single reactor with its configuration. Basis Theory: GET /reactors/{id}.

tools.name: basis_theory_list_permissions
tools.title: List permissions
tools.description: List the permissions that can be granted to an application, optionally for one application type. Basis Theory: GET /permissions.

application_type.description: Only permissions valid for this application type.

tools.name: basis_theory_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List the roles available for tenant members. Basis Theory: GET /roles.

tools.name: basis_theory_get_tenant
tools.title: Get the tenant
tools.description: Fetch the current tenant — name, id and settings. Basis Theory: GET /tenants/self.

tools.name: basis_theory_get_tenant_usage
tools.title: Get the tenant usage report
tools.description: Fetch the tenant's usage report — token counts by type and container, and monthly API call volume. Basis Theory: GET /tenants/self/reports/usage.

tools.name: basis_theory_list_tenant_members
tools.title: List tenant members
tools.description: List the people with access to the tenant, and their roles. Basis Theory: GET /tenants/self/members.
